description: This file defines a React component named ShelfView that displays different categories of books using ShelfCarousel components. It maintains internal state for various book lists and renders them accordingly.

classes.name: ShelfView
classes.description: A React component that displays categorized book shelves with the help of ShelfCarousel components.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ShelfView component with props containing book lists and search text.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the JSX to render four ShelfCarousel components for different book categories.
